descriptions.inProgress: I met #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and gave him Rombot's 3 memory cards, but oh my... he was unable to decipher one of the three, and destroyed it. I'll need to find another one of Rombot's Memory Card for Porter.
descriptions.completed: I watched over Porter's deciphering with an uneasy feeling, but thankfully he didn't make any mistake this time around.
